license.clockHint: Trusted time advances with this FE's monotonic clock. A forward wall-clock jump is pending until confirmed; a rollback only marks suspicion. Local suspicion denies queries only on the master after the settling period; committed suspicion denies on every FE.
license.invalidSlotsWarning: This FE cannot verify the certificates in the slots below; protected reads on this FE return an invalid certificate. Check this FE's signed trust manifest configuration and restart it.

verdict.UNKNOWN: Unknown (fewer than three FEs or no majority)

license.title: License
license.intro: License status comes from this FE. Refresh manually to load the latest snapshot.
license.usageHint: Registered nodes / effective certificate limit. Offline nodes still count; capacity is released after a successful removal.
license.readOnly: Your account can view license status. Certificate details and imports require ADMIN privilege.
license.receiptHelp: Keep the SHA-256 fingerprint to check a submission after a timeout. A receipt confirms that submission, not the currently active certificate. The page never resubmits automatically.
license.refreshRequired: Refresh to load the current session’s license status.
license.sessionChanged: The session or its permissions changed. Previous details and input were cleared. Refresh or sign in again.
license.appliedRefresh: The submission is applied on this FE. Refresh to view its current license status.
license.requestFailed: The license request could not be completed.
license.importHelp: Choose a UTF-8 certificate file or paste its text (maximum 64 KiB). Validate first, then explicitly confirm the import.
license.memoryOnly: The certificate is held only in this dialog’s temporary memory and cleared when closed, submitted, or signed out.
license.validated: Server validation passed. No certificate has been submitted yet.
license.confirmHelp: Confirm to persist this certificate and replace the current active and pending certificates. The server rechecks it against the state at import time and returns the actual changes; a coverage gap may leave queries unavailable.

changes.title: Importing replaces the current license with these changes
changes.warning: The new certificate replaces the current active and pending certificates. These changes take effect on import; re-importing an older certificate cannot undo them, only a new certificate with a higher sequence can. The import response is authoritative.
changes.none: No earlier expiry, lower limit, removed feature, coverage gap or discarded pending certificate compared with the current license.

codes.COVERAGE_GAP: {{gap}}-second coverage gap before the new certificate starts; queries are treated as expired during the gap
codes.PENDING_DISCARDED: Pending certificate {{licenseId}} (sequence {{sequence}}) is replaced and discarded

poll.waiting: Waiting for application: serial checks with backoff, up to 120 seconds. Leaving or hiding this page stops checks.
poll.stopped: Automatic checks are stopped. You can query the receipt manually.
poll.exhausted: The 120-second wait ended. Submission status is unchanged; query the receipt manually.

errors.LICENSE_INVALID_FILE: The file could not be read as UTF-8 text.
errors.LICENSE_NETWORK_ERROR: The request failed or timed out. Automatic checks stopped. If an import was in progress, query its fingerprint before submitting again.
errors.LICENSE_INVALID_RESPONSE: The server returned an unexpected response. Check the receipt if an import was in progress.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: ADMIN privilege is required. Previous details and input were cleared.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: The session expired. Sign in again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: The same-origin security check failed. Verify the reverse proxy preserves the original request origin.
errors.LICENSE_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN: The submission could not be confirmed. Query its receipt; do not assume it failed.
errors.LICENSE_IMPORT_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE: This submission cannot currently be confirmed from the available history.
errors.LICENSE_NOT_READY: License management is not ready. Retry later or query the receipt for an earlier submission.
errors.LICENSE_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Respect the server retry interval.
errors.LICENSE_RENEWAL_REDUCTION: A certificate that starts in the future cannot lower the current FE/BE limit. Issue it to start now, or import it once its start time arrives.
